question: how to get admission
response: Admissions are based on academic merit and entrance exam scores. You can apply online via our admissions portal.

question: what is the admission process
response: The admission process involves online registration, document verification, entrance merit ranking, and fee payment.

question: when do admissions start
response: Admissions typically open in May every year right after board and competitive exam results are declared.

question: eligibility criteria for btech
response: For B.Tech, candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks.

question: eligibility for mba
response: Graduation in any discipline with at least 50% marks and a valid CAT/MAT/CMAT score is required for MBA admission.

question: what documents are required for admission
response: Required documents include 10th & 12th mark sheets, transfer certificate, category certificate (if applicable), entrance scorecard, and passport photos.

question: can i apply online for admission
response: Yes, you can complete the entire application process online via the admissions page on our college website.

question: is there an entrance exam for admission
response: Yes, admissions to engineering and management programs require state or national entrance exam scores such as JEE Main or CAT.

question: what is the last date to apply for admission
response: The deadline for submitting admission applications is July 31st for the upcoming academic session.

question: is lateral entry available
response: Yes, diploma holders in engineering can apply for direct 2nd-year B.Tech admission under the lateral entry scheme.

question: how to check my admission status
response: You can check your application status by logging into the student admissions portal with your registered email and application ID.

question: admission process for international students
response: NRI and international students can apply through the International Students Cell by submitting equivalent qualification credentials.

question: what is the quota for sports students
response: We reserve 5% of seats under the sports and co-curricular quota for state and national level players.

question: how to apply for scholarship
response: Merit-cum-means scholarships are available. Applications open in September through the financial aid office.

question: what courses are offered
response: We offer undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma programs across Engineering, Computer Applications, and Management.

question: tell me about btech streams
response: B.Tech is offered in Computer Science, AI & Machine Learning, Electronics & Communication, Mechanical, and Civil Engineering.

question: do you have computer science engineering
response: Yes, we offer B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering with specializations in AI, Data Science, and Cyber Security.

question: what postgraduate courses are available
response: Postgraduate programs include M.Tech, MBA, and MCA across various specializations.

question: are diploma courses available
response: Yes, three-year polytechnic diploma courses in Civil, Mechanical, and Electrical engineering are offered.

question: what is the course duration for btech
response: B.Tech is a 4-year undergraduate degree program divided into 8 semesters.

question: what is the course duration for mba
response: MBA is a 2-year full-time postgraduate program split into 4 semesters.

question: can i switch my branch in second year
response: Branch migration is permitted after the 1st year based on academic performance (CGPA > 8.5) and seat availability.

question: are there elective courses in final year
response: Yes, students can choose domain-specific open electives and professional electives in their 3rd and 4th years.

question: what is the syllabus for computer science
response: The detailed semester-wise syllabus can be downloaded from the Academic section on our college website.

question: do you offer online certification courses
response: Yes, our college collaborates with NPTEL and Coursera to offer credit-eligible online certification courses.

question: what is the fee structure
response: The fee structure varies by course. B.Tech tuition fee is approximately $1,200 per semester. Detailed break-ups are available on our site.

question: how much is the tuition fee for btech
response: B.Tech tuition fee is approximately $1,200 per semester, excluding hostel and examination charges.

question: what is the mba fee structure
response: MBA tuition fee is approximately $1,500 per semester.

question: how can i pay my college fees
response: Fees can be paid online via Net Banking, UPI, or Credit/Debit Cards through the student ERP portal.

question: can i pay fees in installments
response: Yes, students can request payment in two installments per semester by applying to the Accounts Office.

question: is the fee refundable
response: Fee refunds follow university guidelines. A full refund minus administrative charges is provided if cancellation occurs before classes start.

question: what is the hostel fee
response: Hostel fees are approximately $600 per semester, which includes room accommodation and mess charges.

question: are there late fee penalties
response: Yes, a fine of $5 per day is levied if tuition fees are paid after the official due date.

question: how to get a fee receipt
response: You can download official digital receipts directly from the student ERP portal under the Finance section.

question: are scholarships available for fees
response: Yes, merit-based, economic-need, and category-based fee waivers are provided to qualifying students.

question: what is the exam fee per semester
response: The semester examination fee is $50, payable before downloading the examination hall ticket.

question: when are mid term exams scheduled
response: Mid-term exams are held halfway through each semester, typically in October for odd semesters and March for even semesters.

question: when are final semester exams
response: End-semester examinations are conducted in December (odd semesters) and May (even semesters).

question: what is the passing percentage in exams
response: Students must secure a minimum of 40% in theory and practical components separately to pass a course.

question: how can i view my exam results
response: Results are published on the official student ERP portal. Log in with your roll number to view grade sheets.

question: how to apply for re-evaluation
response: You can apply for paper re-evaluation online through the examination portal within 10 days of result publication.

question: what is the rule for backlogs
response: Backlog examinations are held alongside regular semester exams or during supplementary sessions prior to the academic year.

question: how do i get my hall ticket or admit card
response: Admit cards can be downloaded from the student portal 5 days before exams start, provided all dues are cleared.

question: what happens if i miss an exam due to illness
response: If an exam is missed due to a medical emergency, submit a valid medical certificate to the Controller of Examinations within 3 days.

question: how to get duplicate mark sheet
response: Submit a formal request letter at the examination cell along with an FIR copy (if lost) and the processing fee.

question: what is the attendance criteria for writing exams
response: A minimum of 75% attendance in both lectures and practicals is mandatory to appear for semester exams.

question: when is the exam timetable released
response: Exam timetables are published on the notice board and website 15 days before the commencement of examinations.

response: Summer internships commence in June following the completion of even-semester final examinations.

response: Yes, many corporate partners offer paid stipends ranging from $200 to $800 per month.

response: Submit your internship offer letter along with an application form to your Department Head (HOD) to issue an NOC.

response: You can register for upcoming internship drives through the T&P Cell portal.

response: Yes, remote or virtual internships are permitted subject to prior approval from your departmental coordinator.

question: what is the average stipend for internships
response: The average stipend offered to our students is approximately $300 per month.

response: Yes, students can participate in off-campus hiring drives and must inform the T&P cell upon receiving an offer letter.
